item.tib: dmar khrid dgongs pa yongs 'dus phyag rdzogs dbu ma chen po gsum las sgrub pa grogs kyi btsal thabs yid kyi 'dod 'jo
item.coloph: ces pas 'grogs pa grogs kyi btsal thabs yid kyi 'dod 'jo 'di ni/ nang so bstan 'dzin khu dbon gyi zhabs brdul spyi bos (bo'i) gtsug tu len pas (pa'i) thos chung mu la ha ra bdag gi (gis/) drin chen dam pa'i zhal nas brtsom (rtsoms) par gyis shig gi bka' lung bsten pa dang / bslab pa gsum ldan gyi skyes bu dam pa ngag dbang blo gros rgya mtsho sogs slob ma mang gi (gis) bskul ba la brten nas/ dar rgyas g.yung drung gling du brtsom (brtsams) pa 'dis kyang bstan pa'i rgyan dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'grub par gyur cig/
